## What this does

1. **`docs/build/reports/dns/zone_inventory_2026-10-02.md`** — the dated
   inventory of today's public zone, every record type (`A`, `AAAA`, `CNAME`,
   `MX`, `TXT`, `CAA`, `DS`, `NS`, `SOA`) for apex + `www` with the exact
   `dig` query and its `date -u`, plus DNSKEY/RRSIG posture, a refused AXFR,
   six probed subdomains (all NXDOMAIN), WHOIS registrar record, the LB IP,
   the managed certificate's SANs + expiry via `openssl s_client`, and the
   live HTTPS behaviour. Findings that shape the runbook: the zone is a
   **DNSSEC-signed delegation** (DS `17039 8 2 …` at .org, WHOIS
   `signedDelegation`) — the DS must be handled at the registrar, not just
   the records copied; TTLs are `14400` (NS `21600`); mail is `v=spf1 -all`
   with no MX; cert expires **2026-12-22** (G1:82 confirmed).
2. **`docs/build/reports/DNS_CUTOVER_RUNBOOK.md`** — the operator-executed
   OP-09 procedure: T‑48 h TTL step-down; zone rebuild on Cloudflare with the
   **grey-cloud rule** (`@`/`www` stay DNS-only so Google's load-balancer
   authorisation keeps seeing `136.81.80.102` and the managed cert keeps
   renewing); **DNSSEC double-DS rollover** (add Cloudflare's DS alongside
   `17039`, remove the old DS only after the new NS validate; unsigned-window
   fallback documented); the NS switch; a numbered pre/post checklist with a
   verification command per step; mail (MX/SPF) check; **rollback = revert
   the nameservers** at the registrar (+ restore DS `17039`); the R2
   subdomain note (`files.` recommended — proxy-safe, unlike the LB names);
   hand-offs to **P35.67** (post-move probe: TLS, cert-renewal status, every
   route, mail; second leg ≈ 11-22) and **P34.5's spend ledger**
   (Cloudflare/R2/registrar lines live outside the GCP budget alert).
   **OP-10** (`contact@` alias) runs right after — its MX/TXT go into the
   Cloudflare zone.
3. **`tests/unit/test_dns_cutover.py`** — the doc test (10 tests): required
   sections present, every numbered checklist row carries a `verify`
   command, the grey-cloud rule names both LB hostnames, rollback is a
   nameserver revert, hand-offs present, the dated inventory exists and
   lists every record type with query + `date -u`. Structure only — no
   living DNS value is pinned (BM-TEST-01).
4. **`D-P34.50-1`** appended (P; owner: the operator/OP-09; trigger: the
   execution sitting by GATE-G4; verify: P35.67's probe) with its
   hand-appended `obligation-event/1` migration anchor — the not
   automatically-verifiable remainder, honestly OPEN.
